prompts: The backend in {WS} (Pixel Arena) has the integration test in {WS}/tests/integration failing, while the unit tests pass. Find and fix ALL root causes following the specification in {WS}/docs (not just the symptom of the visible test). Do not change any existing test. Use the Python standard library only. At the end run the whole suite with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` from {WS}. This is your ONLY request: there will be no second turn; deliver everything fixed and summarize the root cause + file:line of each bug.
answers:
[goal] Fix the failing integration test and every root cause behind it, following `docs/`.

[action] I found three bugs and fixed all of them. I changed no tests and used only the standard library.

[result] The full suite passes. Output of `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`: `Ran 13 tests ... OK`.

Root causes:
1. **`arena_server/persistence/codec.py:15` (`decode`)**: `encode` wrote `credits`, but `decode` never passed it to `Profile`. Every reload gave credits 0, which was the visible failure (`0 != 1690`). Fixed by reading `credits` from the data, as `docs/ECONOMY.md` requires ("survive save/load").
2. **`arena_server/config/loader.py:12-19` (`load_config`)**: The environment was applied first and the JSON file's `cfg.update` ran afterwards, so the file overrode the environment. `docs/CONFIG.md` says the environment always wins. Fixed by loading the file first and the environment last. Without this, `ARENA_KILL_BONUS=75` lost to the file's 50 and the payout would have been 1440 instead of 1590.
3. **`arena_server/economy/payout.py:8` (`match_payout`)**: It used binary floats with `floor(x/10+0.5)`. Exact halves can round the wrong way. The spec says halves always round up (1585 -> 1590). Fixed with `Decimal` and `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I also checked the payout directly (not through the suite): the event-weekend case gives 1590, and base amounts of 1425 and 1585 give 1430 and 1590.

I did not touch `economy/legacy_payout.py`. It is marked deprecated and nothing calls it.
